source.title: The Prize Within
source.description: Power radiates from inside the box. This must be the artifact! Now you just need to get it open...
source.objective:
Find a way to open the box and claim the artifact, then deliver it to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind Cathedral.

Provided item:
source.completion:
So the story was true... I will hold on to this and investigate its potential. This could be the defense against the Scourge we need.

Take this, <name>, with my thanks.
